title: Fidelity Balance Daily Event Volume
dataSources: Crypto prices/holdings (`crypto:price`, `wallet:balance`), exchange transactions (`coinbase:txn`), budget/transaction exports (`firefly:txn`, `ynab:txn`), recurring-subscription and bill feeds.
app: Crypto exchange/wallet APIs (Coinbase, on-chain), budgeting exports (YNAB/Firefly III), and subscription trackers via HEC scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=fidelity:balance
| bin _time span=1d
| stats count as events, dc(account_name) as distinct_entities by _time
| sort - _time
description: Counts how many Fidelity balance events land each day and how many distinct account values are represented.
value: Daily volume is the fastest way to spot a dead feed, a sudden burst, or a workflow that quietly changed.
implementation: Ingest Fidelity balance records into `index=personal`; schedule daily and compare count and distinct account values against your normal baseline.
visualization: Column chart of daily event count with a line for distinct entities.
grandmaExplanation: It follows how much Fidelity balance activity showed up each day so you can see if the feed went quiet or suddenly got busy.
